svg.title: Proposed — Design Studio listing station
svg.desc: Listing content-type: main image with Amazon fill guide, secondary image set, A+ module band, and an inspector carrying the compliance pre-flight, bound search terms and claims guardrail.

text.font-family: Libre Baskerville, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
Libre Baskerville, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Listing station — main image, secondary set, A+ content, Brand Story and Storefront, each rendered against the live Amazon requirement set.
Formats, templates, compliance rules and brief fields are all derived from this one choice.
500–10,000 px on the longest side, >1,000 px preferred for zoom · PNG / JPG / TIFF / non-animated GIF

text.font-family: Libre Baskerville, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: none — MAIN forbids text, logos, borders, badges
Reference-locked: every secondary and A+ asset is composited from the same packshot so the product never drifts between panels.
PNG accepted; animated GIF is not
no box or bag in frame
no evidence attached — add a source or remove
Pine & Bone · ink and accent applied
Amazon's own warning: non-compliant images can lead to listing suppression from search results, and content failing validation will not start a Manage Your Experiments test as scheduled.
Each asset is bound to the search terms it is meant to win.
A claim with no attached evidence cannot pass pre-flight. That is the account-safety trade: fewer claims, safer listing.
Main image 1600×1600 PNG · product fills ≥85% of frame · no text, no badge, no inset · claims: 1 unsupported

Render 02 — PROPOSED: Listing station. The engine that draws this already exists (northstar-os-ui/src/studio/**, currently orphaned and uncommitted). What is NEW: the Amazon pre-flight section, the bound search terms, and the claims guardrail. Product composites stay the operator's own photography — no fabricated product imagery.
